args: [PROACTIVE-TRIAGE] Weekday 08:35 local (America/Chicago) post-sweep review for the ctrld-sync pilot (2B, human-in-the-loop). Do NOT push, open PRs, or re-run the sweep. Steps: (1) Read __HOME__/.gemini/antigravity/proactive-reports/$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)-<repo>.md for the pilot repo (ctrld-sync in Week 1; the repo named in the sidecar prompt in Week 2). (2) If no digest exists, run `__HOME__/dev/personal-config/scripts/antigravity-proactive-ctl.sh audit-missed --date $(date -u +%Y-%m-%d) --repo <repo>` once, record Status MISSED in the summary, and do NOT retry or start a run. (3) Otherwise inspect the referenced worktree (git diff --shortstat vs base_sha) and re-check verify exit status from the digest. (3b) If verify did not exit 0, run `__HOME__/dev/personal-config/scripts/antigravity-proactive-ctl.sh base-check --repo <repo> --worktree <worktree_path> --digest <digest_path>` ONCE and report its VERDICT line: FLAKE_ON_RETRY or PRE_EXISTING_ON_BASE (exit 0) means the candidate is still promotable and any base breakage is filed separately, while CAUSED_BY_CHANGE (exit 2) means discard the candidate. Never re-run the sweep to fix a failure that base-check attributes to base. (4) Post a TIGHT summary to the user with exactly these fields: repo, Status, Substatus (NONE|FLOAT_REORDER_DRIFT|GATE_FAILURE|PRE_EXISTING_FAILURE), base-check Verdict when it ran, verify exit code, diff size (files/+/-), and a one-line call: 'worth a look' or 'skip'. Never print secrets or sentinel details beyond the Status and a pointer to the local digest path. Sentinel stays local-only (SECURITY_REPORT_ONLY), never staged for a public PR.
description: Every weekday (Mon-Fri) at 08:35 local (America/Chicago, 20 minutes post-sweep), reviews the proactive digest and outputs a tight triage summary.
